# Meadowlark Kitchen Temperature Log — 06/18/2026
Daily opening and mid-shift checks | Prepared by Caleb Nguyen
## Recorded temperatures
| Time | Location or item | Temperature | Limit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 6:05 AM | Walk-in cooler air | 38°F | 41°F or below |
| 6:10 AM | Walk-in freezer air | -4°F | 0°F or below |
| 6:15 AM | Milk, top shelf | 39°F | 41°F or below |
| 9:40 AM | Cooked chicken, hot line | 137°F | 135°F or above |
| 10:05 AM | Walk-in cooler air | 46°F | 41°F or below |
| 10:12 AM | Sliced turkey, walk-in cooler | 44°F | 41°F or below |
| 11:30 AM | Walk-in cooler air | 39°F | 41°F or below |
## Corrective action and handoff
At 10:05 AM, Megan Hendricks found the walk-in cooler above its limit. The sliced turkey was moved to the backup cooler at 10:15 AM. Brandon Duarte confirmed the walk-in cooler had returned to 39°F at 11:30 AM.
The turkey reading was 44°F at 10:12 AM. Record how long the turkey had been above 41°F and discard it if the time above 41°F exceeded 4 hours.
The freezer was at 0°F at the opening check, so frozen inventory remained within limit. Caleb Nguyen reviewed the log with Megan Hendricks at 11:35 AM and filed it in the kitchen binder.

errors.quote: The turkey reading was 44°F at 10:12 AM.
errors.explanation: The log records turkey at 44°F but does not record how long it had been above 41°F or its disposition. That time assessment is needed to determine whether the turkey must be discarded; the next sentence states the relevant four-hour limit but does not provide the actual elapsed time or action.
errors.fix: The turkey was above 41°F for 20 minutes and was returned to compliant cold holding.

errors.quote: The freezer was at 0°F at the opening check
errors.explanation: The opening-check table records the walk-in freezer at -4°F at 6:10 AM, not 0°F. The narrative's stated reading contradicts the recorded measurement.
errors.fix: The freezer was at -4°F at the opening check
